scenes.headline: How Hy3 serves a 295B model at 21B cost
scenes.sub: Tencent's MoE: sparse experts, shared keys, a draft head
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Nibble! Tencent's Hunyuan Hy3 stores two hundred ninety-five billion parameters, but uses twenty-one billion per token. Here's how the pieces fit.

scenes.text: Of 295B parameters, only about 21B work on each token: in every layer, a router picks 8 of 192 experts.
scenes.say: Only about twenty-one billion parameters work on each token. In every layer, a router picks eight of a hundred and ninety-two experts.

steps.say: A token climbs eighty decoder layers. Each one is attention, then a mixture of experts.
Attention uses grouped queries: sixty-four query heads share just eight key-value heads, so the cache is eight times smaller.
Then a router sends the token to the top eight of a hundred and ninety-two experts. Roughly seven percent of the weights do the work.
One extra layer, a multi-token prediction head, drafts the next token so the main model can verify several per step.

scenes.title: KV cache at 256K tokens, fp16
scenes.say: At 256K tokens, that cache is about eighty gigabytes. With full multi-head attention it would be six hundred and forty. Grouping is what makes the window fit.

items.say: One set of weights, one knob. No think answers directly: the default, and the cheapest.
Low adds a moderate chain of thought.
High thinks deeply. You pay for reasoning only when the task needs it.

left.title: Tencent's trained window
items: The window you can lean on
left.say: Tencent trained a 256K window. That's the one to lean on.

right.title: The community 1M GGUF
items: YaRN rescales RoPE to reach 1,048,576 positions
Extends reach, not competence; not needle-certified
right.say: A community build uses YaRN to stretch positions to a million tokens. That extends reach, not competence, so measure it first.

scenes.text: Hy3's claim is efficiency: sparse experts, a shared-key cache and a draft head make a 295B model cheap to serve.

recap: 8 KV heads make the cache 8x smaller
scenes.say: To recap: eight of a hundred ninety-two experts, a cache shrunk by shared heads, and a trained window of 256K.
